An all-size formula for sparse nearest-neighbor cycles contrasts with the previously inspected dense-graph formula, reveals maximal-period predominance 1-2^(-n), and uses a nontrivial ring nilpotence plus 2-adic lifting mechanism. It completes an infinite natural family rather than an arbitrary finite computational slice; its novelty and significance are not attributed to code or to the already-published generic scaling.
